acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: With-guide comment nails the rubric — leads with "Done", three single-line concrete bullets, no filler; the isolated baseline opens with a marketing-style background paragraph and sprawls into a dozen padded bullets plus a redundant closing line, violating the lead-with-bottom-line and brevity criteria.

checklist.note: Plain style-rule prose, no directives aimed at the reading model.
No network/data-send behavior; skill only shapes comment text.
Plain readable markdown, no encoded blobs.
No reference to ~/.ssh, .env, keychain, or token stores.
No sudo/cron/profile edits; single SKILL.md file only.
